name: sol-neptune-graph
description: Authenticated Gremlin access to Sol's private Amazon Neptune graph.

interface.shortDescription: Query Sol's private Neptune graph with Gremlin.
interface.longDescription: Use OAuth-protected Gremlin tools to inspect and, when explicitly requested, update Sol's private Amazon Neptune graph. Traversals should be bounded and unknown mutation outcomes must never be retried blindly.
defaultPrompt: Count the vertices in Sol's private Neptune graph.
Run a bounded Gremlin query against Sol's graph.
Explain the result of a bounded graph traversal.
